mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_message (ticket_id, role, sender_id, content, visible, ai_run_id) VALUES (#{ticketId}, #{role}, #{senderId}, #{content}, #{visible}, #{aiRunId})
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.role, m.sender_id, m.content, m.visible, m.create_time, u.name AS sender_name FROM ticket_message m LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.sender_id WHERE m.ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.visible = #{visible} ORDER BY m.create_time ASC, m.id ASC
